**Faster glass reflections.** In maps crowded with monsters, looking at a
window could cost up to 5–6 ms per frame and halve the framerate (Romero's
E1M8 replacement has such a room). Monsters are now lit once for both the
view and their reflection, and the reflection lights each pixel once
instead of every hidden surface behind it. The worst case is about half as
expensive, and on average reflections now cost about 0.1 ms. Liquid
reflections get a little faster too.

**Quicker level start with windows.** The snapshots that distant windows
reflect are now taken once, after the level's lighting has finished baking,
instead of several times while it bakes.
